# Getting Help

- **Questions about building a muscle or using the standard:** open a GitHub
  issue; there is a template for doc/spec problems, and general questions are
  welcome too.
- **Commercial licensing of the AeroFlex trademark, partnerships, or private
  questions:** mark@deltaroboticsinc.com
- **Safety-sensitive reports:** see [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md); do not post
  them publicly.
